verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an account or organization can hold multiple API keys with per-key usage logs and a usage endpoint, so a separate key per agent is plausible. Project, session and user IDs only support usage attribution, not access restriction. Nothing in the pack shows keys can be limited to specific endpoints, spend caps or permissions. Missing for 10: per-key endpoint/permission scopes, per-key credit or rate caps, documented key creation/revocation for agents, independent corroboration.
